versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned Mangatan IPA for sideloading.

Built from "bae933fe6d4d08f3079cb7bb977957376b0e97dc". Sign the IPA with your preferred
sideloading tool before installation.

Mihon extensions are hosted on the iPhone itself. OpenJDK is kept
out of the app launch image and loaded only when a Mihon source is
used. The saved external bridge remains available as a fallback.
